validation_scope: Independent offline outcome corpus, compatibility and integration tests; seven equivalent-demand synthetic scheduler repetitions; three partial public live cases. No rich-case live parity claim. 2026-09-11 review: public-provider per-method backoff, refused-method marking, window waits and stranded-attempt recovery added with synthetic and live regression coverage. 2026-09-13: start stops as blocked with a named cause (network_unavailable or identity_unavailable) when the identity reads get no response, writing no lane briefs; failed sends record a URL-free failure category. Synthetic regression coverage; motivated by a live Codex run whose sandbox denied the network to start.
dependency: Self-contained Solana standard-library transport/session; public RPC default
engine_version_meaning: Legacy schema-1 collector compatibility field, matching solana_common.ENGINE_VERSION; v2 collector, workflow and reporting have independent versions.
live_rich_case_parity: live end-to-end run with two lanes, a preset, compose and checkpoint completed on the public endpoint on 2026-09-12 (docs/reviews/solana-review-fixes-2026-09-11.md); completed broad delivery still depends on lane time and provider limits per run
